description: This file defines an enum 'TailscaleNetwork' with methods to detect Tailscale (WireGuard) IPv4 addresses and to identify if an IP address belongs to a Tailscale tailnet.

methods.name: isTailnetIPv4
methods.description: Checks if the given IPv4 address string belongs to a Tailscale tailnet based on specific octet ranges.

methods.name: detectTailnetIPv4
methods.description: Iterates over network interface addresses to find and return a Tailscale IPv4 address if present.
